description: Get full metadata for one or more arXiv papers by ID. Use when you have known IDs from citations, prior search results, or memory. Looks up 10 IDs per call; any further IDs come back in remaining_ids for the next call.

paper_ids.description: arXiv paper IDs, up to 100. The first 10 well-formed IDs are looked up; the rest come back in remaining_ids to pass to the next call. Accepted forms: "2401.12345", "2401.12345v2" (a pinned version), or a pre-2007 ID like "hep-th/9901001" (archive spelled as arXiv issued it), each optionally prefixed "arXiv:", or an arxiv.org abs, pdf, or html URL, with or without https:// or a ?query or #fragment. An ID in any other form is reported in not_found with reason invalid_id and is not looked up.

name: arxiv_get_metadata

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_id`: None of the requested IDs is an arXiv identifier in an accepted form. `no_match`: None of the requested IDs returned data from arXiv. `version_unavailable`: Every requested ID pinned a version the local mirror does not hold, and live arXiv fallback is disabled. `rate_limited`: arXiv has throttled requests (HTTP 429 or "Rate exceeded." body). `invalid_request`: arXiv rejected the request (HTTP 4xx other than 429). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

not_found.description: Per-input explanations for inputs that could not be returned. Absent when nothing failed.

items.description: A requested ID that could not be returned, with the reason it was missed.

id.description: Requested ID that returned no data — in canonical form when it was looked up, as sent when it is not an arXiv ID.

reason.description: Why the paper ID could not be returned.

papers.description: Papers found, in request order. Fewer than requested when an ID is malformed, absent from arXiv, or past the first 10 well-formed IDs.

items.description: arXiv paper metadata — identifier, title, authors, abstract, categories, and links.

categories.description: All arXiv categories assigned to this paper.

remaining_ids.description: Well-formed IDs past the first 10, in canonical form and request order, that this call did not look up. Pass them as paper_ids in the next call. Absent when every well-formed ID was looked up.

title: Arxiv Get Metadata
